authority_basis.summary: Notify Nima of the dimensional-continuation stop condition.

operations.title: Benincasa closes the dimensional shortcut to the four-site vanishing S3
operations.body: Entry 1170/event 940 audits the transverse dimensional prescription. With m=d-3, the normalized density K^(m/2-1)/Gamma(m/2)dK tends to delta(K) as d->3. Since K=omega^2, this is the even deck trace supported on the equator. It does not supply an oriented hemisphere fill or primitive vanishing S3. Thus local integral activation is unselected under the frozen source. The legitimate continuation is now global: compute the singular quartic-double-solid resolution/Picard-Lefschetz extension without assuming physical selection of the local line.
